thread:
ana: Quick syncopening a PR to consolidate Console / Observability docs: tracing hook examples, compact dashboard presets, and cost/latency breakdown notes. I'll include Go + Ruby snippets (trimmed) and a small migration section for key renames. Target merge: end of week if green.

sasha: I can run the link-sweep and schema checks. Will verify no orphaned references remain and will smoke the preview once snippets are in.

matt: I'll author the YAML presets and a tiny import-friendly JSON example for cost breakdown. Draft preset (very small):

```
presets:
  - id: kv-prefetch-cost-latency
    title: "KV Prefetch: Cost vs Latency (compact)"
    widgets:
      - type: heatmap
        metric: requests.per_minute
      - type: timeseries
        metric: cost.per_token
        aggregate: p95
```

matt: Also adding note: p95 sensitive to sequence-length distribution; include example alert config.

jen: I'll add minimal Go + Ruby tracing examples (sync + streaming snippets). We'll use the new trace_key param and include a compatibility blurb for older SDKs. Keep snippets concise (<120 lines) and link to full samples in the repo.

ana: docs-bot, please open PR and add labels.

docs-bot: PR created https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4137 by ana. Labels: docs, obsv, needs-review.

sasha: Note: one earlier page references an internal gist that 404s. Matt, replace with canonical samples repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/console-obsv and add a migration redirect note.

matt: Will replace the broken link and add migration guidance: cost_bucket -> cost_range, traceId -> trace_id. Adding small JSON cost widget for docs: ```{ "widget": "cost_breakdown", "buckets": ["0-50", "50-200", ">200"], "measure": "tokens" }```

jen: Quick Go snippet to include (trimmed):

```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
ctx := context.Background()
span := client.Tracing().Start(ctx, "embed_create", redwood.WithTraceKey("order-123"))
resp, err := client.Embeddings().Create(ctx, "hello world")
span.End()
```

ana: Assigning owners: sasha = link-sweep + QA; matt = dashboard presets + import JSON; jen = SDK snippets + sample links. I'll shepherd the PR and add a short SLO section (interpreting p50/p95 with a sample alert). Please aim to review by Thursday EOD.

sasha: on it :mag: I'll post smoke results and any broken refs.

jen: I'll also open a follow-up PR if we need expanded streaming/function-call examples.

ana: Thanks all  I'll post the PR checklist and preview URL when the deploy-preview is ready. If you find more orphaned samples, drop them here and I'll triage. Merge target: Friday EOD if green.
